explication: Dokploy is a self-hostable PaaS for deploying and operating applications, databases, and containerized services. The main evidenced workflow is a user configuring an application, the API checking access and invoking application services, and those services creating deployment records, building/running workloads locally or remotely, and updating deployment status. The README documents additional product branches including Compose, databases and backups, templates, multi-node operations, Traefik, monitoring, Docker management, and notifications. Some branches are represented by their exact enclosing directories because their implementation was not sampled.
